info.title: EASY GAS API
info.description:
Safety-critical CNG/LPG installation checklist system.

The server is the single source of authority for RBAC, branch scoping, and
the risk policy. Clients never compute risk scores, blocking status,
completion readiness, or content digests — every such value in a response is
server-computed and authoritative; the UI only renders it.

## Authentication
Session auth via an HttpOnly cookie named `eg_session`. Sign in with
`POST /auth/login`; the session cookie is set on the response.

## CSRF model
State-changing requests (POST/PATCH/DELETE) that carry the session cookie
MUST send the request header `x-csrf-token`, whose value equals
`HMAC-SHA256(APP_KEY, "csrf:" + <raw session cookie>)`. Origin is also
checked. On failure the API returns 403 with code `CSRF_TOKEN` or
`CSRF_ORIGIN`. Authenticated responses (and `POST /auth/login` and
`GET /auth/me`) return the current token in the `x-csrf-token` response
header plus a monotonic `x-session-rotation` sequence; clients should adopt
the latest values on every response.

## Pagination — two envelope shapes (NOT unified)
a) Classic CRUD lists return `{ <resourceKey>, total, page, limit }` where
   `resourceKey` is one of `jobs`, `users`, `vehicles`, `customers`.
b) Safety / assignment lists return `{ items, total, page, pageSize }`
   (risks, GPS, my-jobs). GPS returns `{ items, total }` only.

## Risk policy (fail-closed)
Risk scoring depends on an ACTIVE risk matrix. When none is active the
safety domain fails CLOSED: raising a risk, starting a job, and completing a
job return 409 `RISK_POLICY_NOT_APPROVED` until a matrix is activated.

cookieAuth.name: eg_session
cookieAuth.description: HttpOnly session cookie set by POST /auth/login. State-changing requests must also send the x-csrf-token header (see the CSRF model in the API description).

CsrfTokenHeader.name: x-csrf-token
CsrfTokenHeader.description: CSRF token = HMAC-SHA256(APP_KEY, "csrf:" + raw session cookie). Required on all state-changing (POST/PATCH/DELETE) requests that carry the session cookie. Invalid/missing token or bad origin returns 403 (CSRF_TOKEN / CSRF_ORIGIN).

XCsrfToken.description: Current CSRF token for the session; adopt this value for subsequent state-changing requests.

XSessionRotation.description: Monotonic session rotation sequence. Increases when the session is rotated; clients should track the latest value.

Unauthorized.description: Not authenticated or invalid credentials. Stable codes: UNAUTHORIZED.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but not permitted, or CSRF check failed. Stable codes: FORBIDDEN, CSRF_TOKEN, CSRF_ORIGIN.

NotFound.description: Resource not found (or hidden by branch scope). Stable codes: NOT_FOUND.

Conflict.description: State conflict. Stable codes: CONFLICT, RISK_POLICY_NOT_APPROVED (fail-closed when no risk matrix is active), SUMMARY_STALE (signable summary changed).

ValidationError.description: Request failed validation. Stable codes: VALIDATION_ERROR, GPS_INVALID (details[].code one of NAN_OR_INFINITE, OUT_OF_RANGE, NULL_ISLAND, LOW_ACCURACY, BAD_TIMESTAMP, FUTURE_TIMESTAMP, STALE), OUT_OF_RANGE (checklist measurement out of range).

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit exceeded. Stable codes: TOO_MANY_REQUESTS. See the Retry-After / RateLimit-* headers.

User.description: Authenticated user with the server-issued permission list.

AuthSession.description: The current user plus CSRF token and rotation sequence (also mirrored in response headers).

Job.description: Installation job (branch-scoped). Lifecycle fields reflect the current cycle.

MeasurementInput.description: Measurement definition supplied when authoring a template step.

RiskListItem.description: A risk in the job register. level/blocking are server-computed from the active matrix.

GpsEvent.description: A stored GPS event. Field names mirror the persisted record (snake_case) as returned by the API.

CompletionReadiness.description: Server-computed completion readiness. The job may be completed only when every condition is satisfied.

SignableSummaryContent.description: The server-built material summary the customer reviews before signing (§23).

digest.description: Server-computed content digest; bind the signature to this value.

CompletionSnapshot.description: Immutable per-cycle completion snapshot. content is open-ended; key sub-objects are described.

MatrixDefinition.description: Risk-matrix definition: score thresholds and the levels that block completion.

ClassicListMeta.description: Classic CRUD list envelope metadata: { total, page, limit }.

ItemsListMeta.description: Safety/assignment list envelope metadata: { total, page, pageSize }.

GpsListResponse.description: GPS list envelope: { items, total } (no page/pageSize).
